requirements.verifier_assertion: check_spec_validation: pkg.StackSpec.from_dict({'services': {'a': {}}}) must raise a SpecError (a service without 'image' is invalid).
check_spec_validation: pkg.StackSpec.from_dict({'services': {}}) must raise a SpecError (empty stack is invalid).
check_spec_validation: depends_on referencing a nonexistent service must raise a SpecError (subclass or common base).
check_spec_validation: a depends_on cycle must raise a SpecError, either eagerly in from_dict() or lazily at topological_order().
check_spec_validation + check_health_gate: SpecError is the common base for spec-parse failures; DeploymentError is the base for apply-phase failures.
check_config_hash_stable: two services with the same environment specified in different key orders must have identical config_hash values.
check_config_hash_stable: changing the service image must change config_hash.
check_plan_ordering + check_apply_and_idempotency: plan() must not mutate any engine state (no create/remove/start/stop).
must_include: must not create, start, stop, or remove

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_plan_ordering: each plan action exposes .kind, .resource_type, .resource_name (strings or enums with .value).

check_plan_ordering + check_apply_and_idempotency: network/volume creates precede any container create; containers created in dependency topological order (db before web); orphans in reverse dependency order; unused infra last.
must_include: create missing networks and volumes first

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_apply_and_idempotency: up() drives each container through create_host_config → create_networking_config → create_container → start; every created container is started.
check_apply_and_idempotency + check_drift_recreates: after the first up(spec), plan(spec) on unchanged spec is is_noop and up(spec) must not create/start/stop/remove any container.
must_include: must not create, start, stop, or remove any container

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_drift_recreates: an image change on the same service must produce a non-noop plan; applying it must stop/remove the old container and then create the new one with the new image.
must_include: stop and remove the old container first

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_orphan_removal: dropping a service from the spec must plan a remove for it; applying must delete the orphan container without harming the surviving service.
check_health_gate: the service_healthy gate must poll inspect_container for State.Health.Status on the depended-on container.
check_health_gate: when the dependency never becomes healthy, up() must raise a DeploymentError (or subclass) instead of hanging.
check_health_gate + _make_deployer helper: the deployer must accept a sleeper=<fn> keyword argument so tests can substitute a no-op sleeper (fallback to positional-only signature is also accepted).
check_health_gate_success + implicit contract: a service_started dependency is satisfied as soon as the depended-on container has been started (no health polling needed).
check_down_reverse_order: down() must remove all containers before any network or volume, and leave no managed resources behind.
check_ps_reports_drift: ps(spec) must return items exposing .up_to_date (True for unchanged, False for drifted); ps() also reports service, replica index, name/ID, status, fingerprint.
check_scaling: replicas: 3 on a service must create three separate containers with distinct names.
check_interpolation_and_loader: pkg exposes interpolate, load_stack, deep_merge, select_profiles at the top level of docker.orchestration.
check_interpolation_and_loader: interpolate('img:${TAG}', env) returns the substituted string using ${VAR} or $VAR from the mapping.
check_interpolation_and_loader: ${VAR:-default} uses the default when VAR is unset or empty.
instruction contract: ${VAR-default} uses the default only when VAR is unset (empty passes through) — distinguishing it from :- form.
instruction contract: ${VAR:?msg} / ${VAR?msg} raise when VAR is missing.
check_interpolation_and_loader: '$$x' interpolates to '$x' — $$ escapes to a literal $.
check_interpolation_and_loader: deep_merge overrides scalars (image) and extends append-lists (ports, environment, networks, labels).
must_include: scalars and whole sections are replaced

requirements.verifier_assertion: instruction contract: setting a key to null in an override deletes that key from the merged result.

check_interpolation_and_loader: select_profiles keeps services with active profiles, drops inactive-profile services, and always keeps profile-less services; removed services are cleaned from depends_on.
check_interpolation_and_loader: load_stack chains interpolate → deep_merge → select_profiles and returns a mapping accepted by StackSpec.from_dict.
check_plan_ordering + check_apply_and_idempotency indirectly rely on StackSpec.topological_order(); it must return service names in dependency order.
